adjudication.rationale: In new `app/assets/javascripts/embed.js`, the origin check is `if (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1) { return; }`, which only verifies that `e.origin` is a substring of `discourseUrl`. If `discourseUrl` is e.g. `https://forum.example.com/`, an attacker origin like `https://forum.example.co` will satisfy `discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === 0` and bypass the check. That allows an untrusted origin to send a `discourse-resize` message and control `iframe.height` in the embedding page.
